print.heading: User documentation – {name}
print.notice: This document describes the rules of the service on the date above. The rules in force are always those applied by the service when you send files: check the online help for the latest version.

remoteInternalDeposit.on: Internal users already verified can send files from outside the organisation's network, with a code each time.
remoteInternalDeposit.off: Files can only be sent from the organisation's network (or with an invitation).

transferReply.on: Recipients can reply to a transfer by sending files back to the sender.
transferReply.off: Recipients cannot reply to a transfer.

recipientVerification.on: You can require recipients to confirm their address with a code before downloading.
recipientVerification.off: The recipient verification option is not offered.

maxDownloads.on: You can limit the number of downloads of a transfer.
maxDownloads.off: The maximum number of downloads option is not offered.

folders.on: You can send whole folders: their tree is kept.
folders.off: Folders cannot be sent: select the files themselves.

recipientRestrictions.on: Sending is restricted to some recipient domains.
recipientRestrictions.off: No restriction applies to recipient domains.

antivirus.on: Every file is checked by an antivirus before it is made available.
antivirus.off: Files are not checked by an antivirus: the download page says so.
